items.title: The United States CADASIL Consortium: Baseline Findings from a Natural History Study
items.abstract_or_text: Background: and Objectives: Vascular contributions to cognitive impairment and dementia (VCID) represent the second leading cause of dementia and a common comorbidity for reduced functional capacity in many individuals, but clinical management and clinical trial readiness are severely hindered by extreme phenotypic and mechanistic heterogeneity. This study establishes the baseline clinical, functional, and multimodal biomarker characteristics of the first United States (US) cohort of Cerebral Autosomal Dominant Arteriopathy with Subcortical Infarcts and Leukoencephalopathy (CADASIL), serving as a single-cause, monogenic small vessel disease model for sporadic VCID. Methods: Cross-sectional analysis of baseline data collected from October 2022 through January 2025 from a longitudinal cohort at 12 US enrollment sites. Adults from families with a documented NOTCH3 variant were recruited through clinical referrals, medical record review, advocacy organizations, and community outreach. Exclusion criteria included other conditions that prevented interpretation of findings and modified Rankin Scale (mRS) scores greater than 3. Central genetic characterization assigned persons with a pathogenic or likely pathogenic NOTCH3 variant to low-, medium-, or high-risk tiers based on epidermal growth factor-like repeat domains. Standardized assessments included clinical histories, exams, objective cognitive and physical assessments, self-reported, companion-reported, and clinician-rated measures, MRI, genetics, and proteomics acquired under harmonized protocols. Group comparisons used Fishers exact and Kruskal-Wallis tests. Multivariable regression used adjustment for age, sex, race, and education. Results: Of 560 participants completing baseline visits, 46 had variants of unknown significance, and 55 had pending genetic analyses. The analytic cohort included 343 persons with a CADASIL-causing NOTCH3 variant and 116 non-carrier family controls. Median age was 47.9 years (IQR 38.7-59.1), median education was 16 years (IQR 14-17), 62.5% were female, and 91.4% were White. Carriers were classified in CADASIL risk tiers: low (7.0%), medium (18.4%), or high (74.6%). Compared with controls, adjusted odds of classification into a more impaired CDR category were higher in all tiers (OR 2.55-5.08, 95% CI 1.22-11.34). Discussion: The US CADASIL Consortium has established a large, genetics-confirmed cohort spanning presymptomatic to moderate disease stages, providing a robust, harmonized platform to define early biomarker signatures and endpoints for targeted VCID therapies.
items.summary_zh: 美国CADASIL联盟建立了首个多中心、遗传确证的CADASIL自然史队列，并报告其基线临床、影像、遗传与蛋白质组学特征。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 560名入组者和统一的多模态采集为单基因小血管病的早期生物标志物与临床试验终点研究提供了重要基础，但队列以白人参与者为主，外推性仍需检验。
items.abstract_zh: 背景与目的：血管性认知障碍和痴呆（VCID）是第二大痴呆病因，也是许多人功能能力下降的常见共病；但极端的表型与机制异质性严重阻碍了临床管理和临床试验准备。本研究建立了美国首个Cerebral Autosomal Dominant Arteriopathy with Subcortical Infarcts and Leukoencephalopathy（CADASIL）队列的基线临床、功能和多模态生物标志物特征；CADASIL可作为散发性VCID的单病因、单基因小血管病模型。方法：对2022年10月至2025年1月在12个美国入组中心收集的纵向队列基线数据进行横断面分析。通过临床转诊、病历审查、倡导组织和社区外展，从有已记录NOTCH3变异的家系中招募成人。排除标准包括妨碍结果解释的其他疾病，以及改良Rankin量表（mRS）评分大于3。中央遗传学鉴定根据表皮生长因子样重复结构域，将携带致病或可能致病NOTCH3变异者划分为低、中或高风险层级。标准化评估包括临床病史、检查、客观认知和体格评估、自我报告、陪同者报告和临床医师评分，以及在统一方案下采集的MRI、遗传学和蛋白质组学数据。组间比较使用Fisher精确检验和Kruskal-Wallis检验。多变量回归对年龄、性别、种族和教育程度进行了调整。结果：560名参与者完成基线访视，其中46人携带意义未明变异，55人尚待遗传分析。分析队列包括343名携带致CADASIL NOTCH3变异者和116名非携带者家系对照。中位年龄为47.9岁（IQR 38.7-59.1），中位受教育年限为16年（IQR 14-17），62.5%为女性，91.4%为白人。携带者的CADASIL风险层级为：低风险7.0%、中风险18.4%或高风险74.6%。与对照相比，所有层级被归入更严重CDR类别的调整后比值比均更高（OR 2.55-5.08，95% CI 1.22-11.34）。讨论：美国CADASIL联盟已建立一个覆盖症状前至中度疾病阶段的大型遗传确证队列，为界定靶向VCID疗法的早期生物标志物特征和终点提供了稳健、统一的平台。

items.title: Penicillin-clavulanate susceptibility in clinical methicillin-resistant Staphylococcus aureus bloodstream infection strains from the CAMERA2 trial
items.abstract_or_text: Objectives: - Among clinical methicillin-resistant Staphylococcus aureus (MRSA) bloodstream infection (BSI) strains, we sought to determine the prevalence of β-lactam-β-lactamase inhibitor (BLBLI) susceptibility, and its association with oxacillin susceptibility, genotypic factors, and patient characteristics. Methods- Clinical MRSA BSI strains were tested for susceptibility to penicillin-clavulanate by Etest (n=117, 36% of the dataset) and to oxacillin by disk diffusion assay (n=328, 100%). Penicillin-clavulanate susceptibility was defined as MIC ≤2mg/L and oxacillin disk susceptibility as an inhibition zone > 6mm. All strains were whole-genome sequenced, and alleles of mecA annotated. The sensitivity and specificity of the oxacillin disk to predict penicillin-clavulanate 'susceptibility' were assessed. Clinical and genomic associations with BLBLI 'susceptibility' were assessed by calculating odds-ratios (OR). Results -We found 73/117 (62%) and 205/328 (62%) strains to be 'susceptible' to penicillin-clavulanate and oxacillin disk, respectively. Oxacillin disk susceptibility and penicillin-clavulanate susceptibility were highly correlated (sensitivity 97.3% and specificity 95.5%). We therefore used oxacillin disk susceptibility as a proxy for penicillin-clavulanate susceptibility. Comparative genomics of the mecA gene uncovered 8 alleles. The oxacillin disk 'susceptible' phenotype was associated with specific mecA alleles, community-associated MRSA sequence-types (OR 72.8, 95%CI 35.4-162), community acquisition of infection (OR 2.09, 95% CI 1.03-4.27), lower Charlson Comorbidity Index (OR 0.90, 95% CI 0.82-0.98) and SOFA (sequential organ failure assessment) scores at presentation (OR 0.88, 95% CI 0.79-0.98). Conclusion - BLBLI 'susceptibility' is common among MRSA strains and is strongly associated with the strain genotype. Infections caused by BLBLI 'susceptible' strains are associated with specific patients' characteristics, namely younger age, fewer comorbidities, acquisition in the community and milder presentations.
items.summary_zh: CAMERA2试验的MRSA血流感染菌株分析显示，青霉素-克拉维酸表型与苯唑西林纸片表型、mecA等位基因和临床特征相关。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 将表型药敏、全基因组测序与试验来源临床资料结合，有助于界定值得进一步验证的MRSA分层线索；该观察性关联不代表可直接改变治疗方案。
items.abstract_zh: 目的：在临床甲氧西林耐药金黄色葡萄球菌（MRSA）血流感染（BSI）菌株中，我们拟确定对β-内酰胺-β-内酰胺酶抑制剂（BLBLI）的敏感性流行情况，以及其与苯唑西林敏感性、基因型因素和患者特征的关联。方法：采用Etest检测临床MRSA BSI菌株对青霉素-克拉维酸的敏感性（n=117，占数据集36%），并采用纸片扩散法检测对苯唑西林的敏感性（n=328，占100%）。青霉素-克拉维酸敏感性定义为MIC ≤2mg/L，苯唑西林纸片敏感性定义为抑菌圈>6mm。对所有菌株进行全基因组测序，并注释mecA等位基因。评估苯唑西林纸片预测青霉素-克拉维酸“敏感性”的敏感度和特异度。通过计算比值比（OR），评估BLBLI“敏感性”的临床和基因组关联。结果：我们发现，73/117（62%）株对青霉素-克拉维酸“敏感”，205/328（62%）株在苯唑西林纸片试验中“敏感”。苯唑西林纸片敏感性与青霉素-克拉维酸敏感性高度相关（敏感度97.3%，特异度95.5%）。因此，我们以苯唑西林纸片敏感性作为青霉素-克拉维酸敏感性的替代指标。mecA基因的比较基因组学发现8种等位基因。苯唑西林纸片“敏感”表型与特定mecA等位基因、社区相关MRSA序列型（OR 72.8，95%CI 35.4-162）、社区获得性感染（OR 2.09，95% CI 1.03-4.27）、较低Charlson合并症指数（OR 0.90，95% CI 0.82-0.98）及就诊时较低SOFA（sequential organ failure assessment）评分（OR 0.88，95% CI 0.79-0.98）相关。结论：BLBLI“敏感性”在MRSA菌株中常见，并与菌株基因型密切相关。由BLBLI“敏感”菌株引起的感染与特定患者特征相关，即更年轻、合并症更少、社区获得以及较轻的临床表现。
items.author_line: Petersiel N, Duarte-Aguilera M, Daniel D, Hayes AS, Davis JS, Howden BP, Giulieri SG, Tong S

items.title: Uncoded Clinical Features from Multilingual Electronic Health Records in Catalonia: Development and Validation Study
items.abstract_or_text: Background: Unstructured free‑text narratives in electronic health records (EHRs) contain critical clinical information that is not captured by structured standard codes. In Catalonia, primary care notes follow a semi‑structured format known as MEAP (in Catalan). However, extracting structured variables using cloud‑hosted commercial large language models (LLMs) raises substantial data privacy concerns and incurs high operational costs. Objective: To develop and validate a privacy-preserving local hybrid pipeline combining a lightweight small language model (SLM) with deterministic regular expressions for extracting six uncoded urinary tract infection (UTI) clinical features (fever, nitrites, leukocytes, lumbar pain, abdominal pain, and haematuria) from primary care EHR narratives. Methods: We deployed the open‑weight model (Phi4-mini, 3.8B parameters) within the institutional firewall using Ollama. Prompts were iteratively refined in collaboration with clinicians, and regular expressions were applied post‑inference. Validation was conducted across two independent arms: (1) a double‑blind clinician gold standard review of 60 real patient records (consensus‑resolved cases), and (2) an adversarial synthetic dataset of 720 notes enriched with linguistic noise, generated using GPT‑4.1 and Grok‑4.1. Point estimates and 95% confidence intervals (CIs) were computed for key performance metrics. Results: The pipeline processed 15,498 MEAP narratives from a matched cohort of 2,962 primary care patients and identified 4,663 clinical feature occurrences. Patients progressing to acute pyelonephritis (cases) presented a higher features burden than non-progressing controls (71.3% vs. 55.8%; standardized mean difference [SMD] = 0.326), particularly for fever (33.0% vs. 9.0%; SMD = 0.616) and lumbar pain (29.0% vs. 9.8%; SMD = 0.502). In real-world clinician validation, overall performance yielded 93.8% accuracy (95% CI 90.6%-96.1%), 83.6% sensitivity (95% CI 73.0%-91.2%), 96.6% specificity (95% CI 93.6%-98.4%), 87.1% positive predictive value (PPV; 95% CI 77.0%-93.9%), and 95.5% negative predictive value (NPV; 95% CI 92.3%-97.7%). In synthetic stress-testing, the pipeline demonstrated 87.2% accuracy (95% CI 84.6%-89.6%), 73.9% sensitivity (95% CI 68.9%-78.5%), near-perfect specificity (99.5%, 95% CI 98.1%-99.9%), and 99.2% PPV (95% CI 97.2%-99.9%). Conclusions: A privacy-preserving local hybrid framework combining a compact open-weight SLM with regular expression rules achieves high specificity and precision for extracting six uncoded clinical features from multilingual primary care narratives. Running entirely within institutional servers, this approach keeps patient data secure, meets privacy standards, and avoids Application Programming Interface (API) costs, making it a practical tool for EHR research, though with lower sensitivity for narratively complex descriptions.
items.summary_zh: 研究在加泰罗尼亚多语种基层EHR中，以本地Phi4-mini与规则抽取未编码的尿路感染临床特征，并在真实病历和合成压力测试中验证。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 15,498条病历叙述与盲法临床标注验证表明，本地小模型结合规则可在不出院内数据的条件下进行信息抽取；其对复杂叙述的灵敏度较低。
items.abstract_zh: 背景：电子健康记录（EHR）中的非结构化自由文本叙述含有关键临床信息，而这些信息未被结构化标准编码捕获。在加泰罗尼亚，基层医疗记录采用称为MEAP（加泰罗尼亚语）的半结构化格式。然而，使用云托管商业大语言模型（LLM）提取结构化变量会引发重大的数据隐私担忧，并带来较高运营成本。目的：开发并验证一种保护隐私的本地混合流水线，将轻量级小语言模型（SLM）与确定性正则表达式结合，从基层医疗EHR叙述中提取6项未编码的尿路感染（UTI）临床特征：发热、亚硝酸盐、白细胞、腰痛、腹痛和血尿。方法：我们在机构防火墙内使用Ollama部署开放权重模型Phi4-mini（38亿参数）。与临床医师协作迭代优化提示词，并在推理后应用正则表达式。验证分为两个独立部分：（1）对60份真实患者记录进行双盲临床医师金标准审查（对有分歧的病例达成共识）；（2）使用GPT-4.1和Grok-4.1生成的、富含语言噪声的720条对抗性合成笔记数据集。对关键性能指标计算点估计和95%置信区间（CI）。结果：该流水线处理了2,962名基层医疗患者匹配队列中的15,498条MEAP叙述，识别出4,663处临床特征出现。进展为急性肾盂肾炎的患者（病例）比未进展对照具有更高的特征负担（71.3% vs. 55.8%；标准化均差[SMD] = 0.326），尤其是发热（33.0% vs. 9.0%；SMD = 0.616）和腰痛（29.0% vs. 9.8%；SMD = 0.502）。在真实世界临床医师验证中，总体性能为准确率93.8%（95% CI 90.6%-96.1%）、敏感度83.6%（95% CI 73.0%-91.2%）、特异度96.6%（95% CI 93.6%-98.4%）、阳性预测值（PPV）87.1%（95% CI 77.0%-93.9%）和阴性预测值（NPV）95.5%（95% CI 92.3%-97.7%）。在合成压力测试中，该流水线表现为准确率87.2%（95% CI 84.6%-89.6%）、敏感度73.9%（95% CI 68.9%-78.5%）、近乎完美的特异度99.5%（95% CI 98.1%-99.9%）和99.2%的PPV（95% CI 97.2%-99.9%）。结论：将紧凑开放权重SLM与正则表达式规则结合的保护隐私本地框架，对于从多语种基层医疗叙述中提取6项未编码临床特征，具有较高特异度和精确度。该方法完全在机构服务器内运行，可保障患者数据安全、符合隐私标准并避免Application Programming Interface（API）成本，使其成为EHR研究的实用工具，但对叙述复杂的描述敏感度较低。
items.author_line: Ouchi D, Riudavets S, Franquet A, Fernández-García S, Llor C, Moragas Moreno A, Giner-Soriano M, Torres F, Morros R

items.title: An Outcome-Independent Analytical Framework Reveals Systemic Discordance Between a Continuous Neural-Mesenchymal Programme and Consensus Molecular Subtyping in Colorectal Cancer: A Multi-Cohort Transcriptomic Study
items.abstract_or_text: Abstract An outcome-independent strategy is presented for deriving a continuous programme score from co-expression structure alone, then testing its agreement with an established classifier across independent cohorts. Consensus Molecular Subtyping (CMS) groups colorectal cancer (CRC) transcriptomes into discrete categories; CMS4 denotes mesenchymal, stromal-rich disease. The question addressed is whether a continuous neural-mesenchymal (NEM) programme, built from a curated 14-gene panel under a pre-specified correlation threshold, tracks CMS4 assignment without being reducible to it. In a TCGA-COAD discovery cohort (n = 499), a four-gene module (GAP43, VIM, ZEB1, TWIST1) emerged as the only combination for which every pairwise Spearman correlation exceeded r = 0.50 (r = 0.51–0.74); the module was fixed before external validation and never trained against CMS or outcome data. The resulting NEM score correlated strongly with Hallmark EMT ssGSEA activity (r = 0.93) and identified 96.3% of CMS4 samples correctly. NEM-High status was not confined to CMS4, however: 35.3% of NEM-High tumours in the discovery cohort fell within CMS1–CMS3, a pattern that held across nine external GEO cohorts (24.0–46.8%, mean 38.0%, n ≈ 3,742). NEM-High status carried a numerically elevated but non-significant hazard of death (HR = 1.44–1.53, p > 0.05). A median-split sensitivity check and a leave-VIM-out re-scoring each ruled out dichotomisation and gene-set overlap as explanations. An orthogonal Human Protein Atlas cross-check found no single module gene independently prognostic in COAD or READ, favouring a module-level interpretation. Continuous NEM activity and categorical CMS status describe overlapping but distinct aspects of CRC biology: a compact, correlation-derived module reconstructs most of a subtype's membership while still detecting programme activity the label leaves out.
items.summary_zh: 多队列转录组研究以预先固定的4基因NEM模块刻画结直肠癌连续神经-间质程序，并检验其与CMS4分型的一致性和差异。
items.why_it_matters_zh: TCGA发现队列与9个外部GEO队列支持连续程序评分可补充分型标签，但生存关联未达显著，不能将其视为预后标志物。
items.abstract_zh: 本文提出一种不依赖结局的策略：仅从共表达结构推导连续程序评分，随后检验其与既有分类器在独立队列中的一致性。共识分子分型（CMS）将结直肠癌（CRC）转录组划分为离散类别；CMS4表示间质性、富含基质的疾病。所要回答的问题是：在预先指定的相关性阈值下，由精心筛选的14基因面板构建的连续神经-间质（NEM）程序，是否追踪CMS4归类而又不能被其简化替代。在TCGA-COAD发现队列（n = 499）中，4基因模块（GAP43、VIM、ZEB1、TWIST1）是唯一所有两两Spearman相关均超过r = 0.50（r = 0.51-0.74）的组合；该模块在外部验证前即被固定，且从未针对CMS或结局数据训练。所得NEM评分与Hallmark EMT ssGSEA活性强相关（r = 0.93），并正确识别96.3%的CMS4样本。然而，NEM-High状态并不限于CMS4：发现队列中35.3%的NEM-High肿瘤属于CMS1-CMS3，这一模式在9个外部GEO队列中仍成立（24.0-46.8%，平均38.0%，n ≈ 3,742）。NEM-High状态具有数值上升高但未显著的死亡风险比（HR = 1.44-1.53，p > 0.05）。中位数二分敏感性检查和去除VIM后的重新评分均排除了二分法和基因集重叠对结果的解释。对Human Protein Atlas的正交交叉核查发现，没有单个模块基因在COAD或READ中独立具有预后意义，这支持模块层面的解释。连续NEM活性和类别CMS状态描述了CRC生物学中重叠但不同的方面：一个紧凑、由相关性推导的模块重建了一个亚型的大部分成员资格，同时仍能检测到该标签遗漏的程序活性。

items.title: A Reproducible Framework for Auditing the Trustworthiness of Clinical Machine Learning Models
items.abstract_or_text: Abstract The deployment of machine learning (ML) models for clinical risk prediction is frequently challenged by domain shift when algorithms are transferred across heterogeneous healthcare settings. Conventional evaluation primarily emphasizes discriminative performance, such as the area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (ROC-AUC), which may overlook failures in probability calibration, explainability stability, robustness, and clinical utility. To address these challenges, we present AETHEL, an open-source and reproducible framework for systematically auditing the trustworthiness of clinical ML models. The framework evaluates multiple classification and survival models using harmonized datasets, including the Framingham Heart Study and the National Health and Nutrition Examination Survey (NHANES), through integrated assessment of discrimination, calibration, explainability, robustness, clinical utility, and cross-cohort generalization. Experimental evaluation demonstrates measurable degradation in predictive performance and calibration following cross-cohort transfer. While post-hoc calibration using Platt Scaling and Isotonic Regression improves probability calibration, explainability analyses reveal shifts in feature attribution under covariate drift. To quantify explanation stability, we introduce the Feature Agreement Score (FAS) and Top-k Jaccard Overlap (TkO) metrics, alongside visual clinical consequence analyses based on Decision Curve Analysis. AETHEL provides a unified, reproducible framework for auditing the trustworthiness of clinical machine learning models, supporting transparent evaluation and more informed deployment decisions in clinical settings.
items.summary_zh: AETHEL是用于临床机器学习可信度审计的开源可复现框架，联合评估判别力、校准、解释稳定性、鲁棒性、临床效用和跨队列泛化。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 框架在Framingham Heart Study和NHANES上实证显示跨队列迁移会损害性能与校准，并把解释稳定性纳入可度量审计。
items.abstract_zh: 临床风险预测机器学习（ML）模型的部署，在算法迁移至异质医疗场景时经常面临领域偏移的挑战。传统评估主要强调判别性能，例如受试者工作特征曲线下面积（ROC-AUC），这可能忽视概率校准、可解释性稳定性、鲁棒性和临床效用方面的失效。为应对这些挑战，我们提出AETHEL，这是一个开源且可复现的框架，用于系统审计临床ML模型的可信度。该框架使用包括Framingham Heart Study和National Health and Nutrition Examination Survey（NHANES）在内的协调数据集，对多个分类和生存模型进行评估，综合考察判别力、校准、可解释性、鲁棒性、临床效用和跨队列泛化。实验评估表明，跨队列迁移后预测性能和校准均出现可测量的下降。虽然使用Platt Scaling和Isotonic Regression进行事后校准可改善概率校准，但可解释性分析显示，在协变量漂移下特征归因发生变化。为量化解释稳定性，我们引入Feature Agreement Score（FAS）和Top-k Jaccard Overlap（TkO）指标，并结合基于Decision Curve Analysis的可视化临床后果分析。AETHEL为审计临床机器学习模型的可信度提供了统一、可复现的框架，支持更透明的评估和更具信息依据的临床环境部署决策。

items.title: Identical runs disagree more than different models: reproducibility limits in deep learning for brain-tumour MRI classification
items.abstract_or_text: Abstract Purpose. Ablation studies in medical imaging routinely report differences of one or two accuracy points. If nominally identical training runs vary by as much, such comparisons may not reliably identify which model should advance to clinical validation. We measure that variation and identify its causes. Methods. A graph-augmented Vision Transformer was evaluated on 3064 contrast-enhanced T1 MRI slices from 233 patients: a seven-cell ablation at three seeds under a patient-wise split, four baselines, a graph-only control, plus low-data and corruption studies. Configurations were retrained at identical seeds, and divergence bisected across fresh processes using SHA-256 parameter fingerprints. 100 runs are reported. Results. Two runs of one configuration at one seed differ by 0.0265 accuracy over six matched pairs, exceeding the 0.0113 architectural contrast under test; the graph branch gives −0.0004 accuracy (95% CI −0.018 to +0.017). Two causes: the seed was applied after model construction, leaving initialisation uncontrolled; and after repair, divergence persists, associated with the fused attention backward though the framework reports full determinism. Image-wise rather than patient-wise splitting inflates accuracy by 0.044. Conclusion. Verify that each seed binds the stochastic sources it should, and report a measured replication scale. Both cost less than one ablation cell.
items.summary_zh: 脑肿瘤MRI深度学习消融研究量化了重复训练和数据划分带来的性能不确定性，并定位了随机性控制不足等来源。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 100次运行、患者级划分和参数指纹追踪说明，微小模型差异可能小于重复训练波动；这对医学影像模型的报告与临床验证前筛选具有直接方法学价值。
items.abstract_zh: 目的。医学影像中的消融研究通常报告一两个准确率百分点的差异。若名义上相同的训练运行也会出现同等幅度的变异，此类比较可能无法可靠识别应推进到临床验证的模型。我们测量这种变异并识别其原因。方法。在233名患者的3064张增强T1 MRI切片上评估图增强Vision Transformer：采用患者级划分、3个随机种子的7单元消融、4个基线、一个仅图结构对照，以及低数据量和损坏研究。以相同随机种子重新训练各配置，并使用SHA-256参数指纹在新进程中二分定位差异。共报告100次运行。结果。同一配置在同一随机种子下的两次运行，在6对匹配比较中准确率相差0.0265，超过所检验的0.0113架构差异；图分支带来−0.0004准确率变化（95% CI −0.018至+0.017）。存在两个原因：随机种子在模型构建后才应用，使初始化未受控制；修复后差异仍存在，并与融合注意力反向传播相关，尽管框架报告完全确定性。按图像而非按患者划分会将准确率抬高0.044。结论。应验证每个随机种子是否绑定了应当绑定的随机源，并报告实测的重复尺度。这两项工作的成本均低于一个消融单元。

items.title: An auditable evidence compiler for large language model-assisted systematic reviews
items.abstract_or_text: Background: Large language models (LLMs) can support systematic reviews, but accurate individual outputs do not establish whether the final synthesis preserves the clinical question, accounts for statistical dependence and incorporates corrections. Objective: To develop and evaluate a framework linking LLM-assisted evidence processing to a versioned, auditable release of synthesis outputs. Methods: We used LLM agents to interpret sources and extract data. Deterministic code enforced statistical rules; investigators resolved material ambiguities and authorized release. We specified ten release properties covering evidence identities, statistical contributions and propagation of corrections. We retrospectively evaluated six integrity domains and historical failure events in one registered prognostic review, without an external comparator or held-out domain. Results: Fifty distinct root-cause events were documented, including 12 that had changed a pooled result before correction. Forty-six were resolved, and four remained disclosed limitations. The corpus comprised 454 reports, 445 studies, 441 cohort entities and 421 dependence clusters. Forty-one of 49 registered analyses were fitted, and eight retained explicit non-fitted states. All 39 source records across five principal analysis families reached a terminal source state. Two implementations within the project agreed across 1,217 numerical comparisons. All 94 file comparisons between release and publication packages were byte-identical. Two reviewers confirmed 39 principal records after seeing the same recommendations. Conclusions: This case provides a framework for inspecting synthesized evidence together with its provenance, statistical meaning and correction history. Comparative validity, generalizability and benefit in patient-centred care require independent evaluation.
items.summary_zh: 该研究提出面向LLM辅助系统综述的可审计证据编译器，将来源身份、统计贡献、校正传播和版本化发布连接起来。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 在一个注册预后综述中，框架记录了50个根因事件并使两个实现的1,217项数值比较一致；其比较有效性与患者获益仍待独立评估。
items.abstract_zh: 背景：大语言模型（LLM）可以支持系统综述，但单个输出准确并不能证明最终综合保留了临床问题、考虑了统计依赖性并纳入了校正。目的：开发并评估一个框架，将LLM辅助的证据处理连接到经过版本控制、可审计的综合输出发布。方法：我们使用LLM agents解读来源并提取数据。确定性代码执行统计规则；研究者解决实质性歧义并授权发布。我们规定了10项发布属性，涵盖证据身份、统计贡献和校正传播。我们在一项已注册的预后综述中，回顾性评估了6个完整性领域和历史失效事件，但未设置外部比较器或留出领域。结果：共记录50个不同的根因事件，其中12个在校正前曾改变合并结果。46个已解决，4个仍作为披露的局限。语料库包括454篇报告、445项研究、441个队列实体和421个依赖性簇。49项注册分析中有41项已拟合，8项保留明确的未拟合状态。5个主要分析家族中全部39条来源记录均达到终止来源状态。项目内的两个实现，在1,217项数值比较中一致。发布包与论文包之间的全部94项文件比较均逐字节一致。两名审阅者在看到相同建议后确认了39条主要记录。结论：该案例提供了一个框架，可连同其来源、统计含义和校正历史一起检查综合证据。比较有效性、可泛化性以及以患者为中心照护中的获益仍需要独立评估。
items.author_line: Yin C, Jing Z, Zhang Z

items.title: Artificial Intelligence for Alzheimer’s Disease Detection Across Neuroimaging and Speech: A Reproducible Cross-Modal Secondary Analysis
items.abstract_or_text: Abstract Artificial-intelligence (AI) systems for Alzheimer’s disease (AD) increasingly use neuroimaging or spontaneous speech, but reported performance is difficult to interpret across studies because cohorts, endpoints, languages, preprocessing, and validation protocols differ. We applied a systematic coding framework to a predefined 51-reference evidence corpus and performed a conservative secondary quantitative synthesis. Twenty-six references met prespecified criteria for primary empirical AI studies: 7 neuroimaging and 19 speech/language studies. Fourteen studies contributed 15 model-level benchmark entries with extractable headline accuracy. Neuroimaging entries ranged from 66.25–99.95% (median 97.74%); speech/language entries ranged from 78.70–92.08% (median 83.81%). These values are descriptive and are not pooled diagnostic-effect estimates. Only 5/26 primary studies (19.2%) explicitly evaluated external, cross-domain, or cross-language generalization, 5/26 (19.2%) used explicit multimodal input, and 4/26 (15.4%) emphasized explainability or uncertainty. Multilingual or cross-lingual evaluation appeared in 3/19 speech/language studies (15.8%). The evidence therefore supports a distinction between high within-study accuracy and clinically credible transportability. Independent validation, patient-disjoint evaluation, calibrated uncertainty, representative cohorts, and linguistically diverse testing should be treated as core design requirements rather than optional extensions. The study-level coding table and benchmark extract are provided for reproducibility and updating.
items.summary_zh: 该可复现二次分析系统编码阿尔茨海默病影像与语音AI研究，强调高内部准确率不能替代可迁移的临床证据。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 26项原始研究中仅5项明确评估外部、跨领域或跨语言泛化，为阿尔茨海默病AI的验证设计与证据解读提供了量化警示。
items.abstract_zh: 用于阿尔茨海默病（AD）检测的人工智能（AI）系统日益使用神经影像或自发言语，但由于队列、终点、语言、预处理和验证方案不同，研究间报告的性能难以解释。我们对预先定义的51篇参考文献证据语料应用系统编码框架，并进行了保守的二次定量综合。26篇参考文献满足原始实证AI研究的预设标准：其中7项为神经影像研究，19项为语音/语言研究。14项研究提供了15条可提取主要准确率的模型级基准条目。神经影像条目的范围为66.25-99.95%（中位数97.74%）；语音/语言条目的范围为78.70-92.08%（中位数83.81%）。这些数值是描述性的，并非合并的诊断效应估计。仅5/26项原始研究（19.2%）明确评估了外部、跨领域或跨语言泛化，5/26项（19.2%）使用了明确的多模态输入，4/26项（15.4%）强调可解释性或不确定性。19项语音/语言研究中有3项（15.8%）进行了多语种或跨语言评估。因此，证据支持区分较高的研究内准确率与具有临床可信度的可迁移性。独立验证、患者不重叠的评估、经校准的不确定性、有代表性的队列和语言多样性测试，应被视为核心设计要求而非可选扩展。研究级编码表和基准提取结果已提供，以便复现和更新。

items.title: Muscle fibre-resolved spatial transcriptomics of regeneration, necrosis and border zones in human paraspinal muscle
items.abstract_or_text: Abstract Focal necrotizing lesion fields in human skeletal muscle contain a mosaic of necrotic fibres, regenerative fibres, and morphologically preserved neighbouring fibres, but their fibre-resolved molecular organisation remains poorly defined. We applied targeted Xenium spatial transcriptomics to a human lumbar paraspinal muscle biopsy with toxic myopathy and integrated the analysis with serial post-run hematoxylin and eosin stain, adult and neonatal myosin heavy-chain isoforms, immunostaining for membrane attack complex of complement (C5b9) and manual fibre-level region-of-interest segmentation. Distant normal type 1 and type 2 fibres, necrotic fibres, regenerative fibres, and intact type 1 and type 2 fibres immediately adjacent to necrosis or regeneration were compared. Baseline transcriptional differences between distant normal type 1 and type 2 fibres were modest, whereas lesion-associated contrasts were substantially broader, indicating that pathological state outweighed basal fibre identity within this targeted panel. Necrotic fibre regions were enriched for immune/myeloid-associated transcripts, including PLA2G7 , TREM2 , FCGR3A , MS4A4A , CD163 , MRC1 , and PTPRC , whereas regenerative fibres preferentially expressed structural and calcium-handling genes, including MYBPC1 , DES , MEF2C , S100A1 , and PVALB . Despite preserved morphology, fibres bordering necrosis displayed a pronounced border-zone signature that largely overlapped the necrotic programme, whereas neighbourhood effects around regeneration were weaker and fibre-type dependent. These findings define necrosis, regeneration, and their border zones as distinct spatial states within a focal human muscle lesion and indicate that fibres adjacent to necrosis, despite being morphologically normal, are unsuitable internal comparators.
items.summary_zh: 研究以Xenium空间转录组、组织学与免疫染色解析一份人腰旁肌毒性肌病活检中坏死、再生及边界区肌纤维的空间状态。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 纤维分辨率结果提示形态正常的坏死邻近纤维并非合适内部对照；但证据来自单一活检和靶向面板，需在更多样本中复现。
items.abstract_zh: 人骨骼肌中的局灶性坏死病灶区域包含坏死纤维、再生纤维和形态保留的邻近纤维镶嵌体，但其纤维分辨率的分子组织仍缺乏明确定义。我们对一份毒性肌病患者的人腰旁肌活检应用靶向Xenium空间转录组，并将分析与连续的运行后苏木精-伊红染色、成人和新生儿肌球蛋白重链同工型、补体膜攻击复合物（C5b9）免疫染色以及手工纤维级感兴趣区域分割整合。比较了远端正常1型和2型纤维、坏死纤维、再生纤维，以及紧邻坏死或再生区域的完整1型和2型纤维。远端正常1型与2型纤维之间的基础转录差异较小，而病灶相关对比显著更广，表明在该靶向面板中病理状态的重要性超过基础纤维身份。坏死纤维区域富集免疫/髓系相关转录本，包括PLA2G7、TREM2、FCGR3A、MS4A4A、CD163、MRC1和PTPRC；而再生纤维优先表达结构和钙处理相关基因，包括MYBPC1、DES、MEF2C、S100A1和PVALB。尽管形态保留，坏死边缘的纤维显示出显著的边界区特征，该特征与坏死程序大体重叠；而再生周围的邻域效应较弱且依赖于纤维类型。这些发现将坏死、再生及其边界区界定为局灶性人肌肉病灶中的不同空间状态，并表明尽管形态正常，邻近坏死的纤维并不适合作为内部比较对象。
items.author_line: MEZNARIC M, Šink Ž, Cokan KB, Zmzljak UP, Horvat S, Umek N

items.title: Polymorph-Dependent Success of Generative Protein Design Against Amyloid Fibrils: A Cross-Method Benchmark Including AL Amyloidosis
items.abstract_or_text: Abstract Generative protein design tools such as diffusion-based backbone generators and AlphaFold2-hallucination pipelines have been validated almost exclusively on globular receptor and signaling-protein targets. Whether these methods generalize to amyloid fibrils - flat, pocket-less, cross-beta surfaces that are structurally unlike any benchmark target used to date - is unknown. We benchmarked three generative design tools (RFdiffusion3, BindCraft, and BindEnergyCraft) for their ability to design binders against eight cryo-EM fibril structures spanning three amyloid diseases: AL (immunoglobulin light-chain) amyloidosis, Parkinson's disease (alpha-synuclein), and Alzheimer's disease (amyloid-beta). AL amyloid has not previously been attempted with any of these tools. Using a common AlphaFold2-Multimer scoring oracle and a mandatory ProteinMPNN sequence-redesign step for diffusion-generated backbones, we found that design success is polymorph-dependent rather than disease-dependent: amyloid-beta fibrils resisted all three methods (interface predicted template modeling score, i_pTM, 0.09-0.15 across both polymorphs tested, and zero accepted designs across 83 combined AF2-hallucination trajectories), alpha-synuclein was largely tractable (three of four polymorphs reaching i_pTM >= 0.70), and AL amyloid split evenly between the two extremes (i_pTM 0.235 for one polymorph, 0.585 for another). Diffusion-based backbone generation (RFdiffusion3) produced confident designs on several targets where AF2-hallucination-based methods (BindCraft, BindEnergyCraft) produced none. Across all RFdiffusion3 designs, binder beta-sheet-forming amino acid propensity correlated strongly with predicted interface confidence (Pearson r = 0.80, p = 8.0) hardware, excluding Turing-generation GPUs entirely. This is, to our knowledge, the first computational feasibility assessment of generative binder design against AL amyloid, and the first systematic comparison of these tools on any amyloid fibril target.
items.summary_zh: 跨方法计算基准评估RFdiffusion3、BindCraft和BindEnergyCraft在AL淀粉样变性、α-synuclein与amyloid-beta纤维上的结合蛋白设计可行性。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 结果提出设计成功可能取决于纤维结构多态性而非疾病名称，并比较了生成工具；所有结论均基于AlphaFold2-Multimer预测，尚无结合或功能实验验证。
items.abstract_zh: 扩散式骨架生成器和AlphaFold2幻觉流水线等生成式蛋白质设计工具，几乎只在球状受体和信号蛋白靶点上得到验证。这些方法能否泛化到淀粉样纤维——平坦、无口袋、交叉β表面，其结构与迄今使用的任何基准靶点均不同——尚不清楚。我们对3种生成式设计工具（RFdiffusion3、BindCraft和BindEnergyCraft）进行基准测试，以评估其针对来自3种淀粉样疾病的8个冷冻电镜纤维结构设计结合蛋白的能力：AL（免疫球蛋白轻链）淀粉样变性、Parkinson's disease（alpha-synuclein）和Alzheimer's disease（amyloid-beta）。此前尚未使用这些工具尝试过AL淀粉样蛋白。使用共同的AlphaFold2-Multimer评分预言机，并对扩散生成骨架强制进行ProteinMPNN序列重新设计，我们发现设计成功取决于多态性而非疾病：amyloid-beta纤维对全部3种方法均有抵抗性（所测试两个多态性中界面预测模板建模评分i_pTM为0.09-0.15，且83条合并AF2-hallucination轨迹中零个设计被接受），alpha-synuclein大体可处理（4种多态性中3种达到i_pTM >= 0.70），而AL淀粉样蛋白在两种极端之间均等分布（一种多态性的i_pTM为0.235，另一种为0.585）。基于扩散的骨架生成（RFdiffusion3）在若干靶点上产生了高置信度设计，而基于AF2-hallucination的方法（BindCraft、BindEnergyCraft）未产生任何设计。在所有RFdiffusion3设计中，结合蛋白形成β-折叠的氨基酸倾向与预测界面置信度强相关（Pearson r = 0.80，p = 8.0）硬件，完全排除了Turing-generation GPUs。据我们所知，这是首次对AL淀粉样蛋白进行生成式结合蛋白设计的计算可行性评估，也是首次在任何淀粉样纤维上对这些工具进行系统比较。

items.title: Polymorph-Independent Resistance to Generative Protein Design Across Five Tau Fibril Folds: A Cross-Tauopathy Benchmark
items.abstract_or_text: Abstract Generative protein-binder-design tools such as diffusion-based backbone generators have recently been benchmarked against amyloid fibril targets, where success was found to depend on the specific structural polymorph rather than the disease of origin: some fibril folds are tractable, others uniformly resistant. Whether this polymorph-dependence generalizes to tau, the aggregating protein in Alzheimer's disease and a family of non-Alzheimer's tauopathies, is untested. We benchmarked RFdiffusion3 with mandatory ProteinMPNN sequence redesign against five distinct cryo-EM tau fibril folds spanning five tauopathies: Alzheimer's disease (paired helical filament), chronic traumatic encephalopathy, Pick's disease, corticobasal degeneration, and progressive supranuclear palsy, scoring all candidates through a common AlphaFold2-Multimer oracle. In contrast to the polymorph-dependent pattern reported for AL amyloidosis and alpha-synuclein, all five tau folds proved resistant to binder design (best interface predicted template modeling score, i_pTM, 0.116-0.401 across folds), with even the most tractable fold (progressive supranuclear palsy) falling short of the tractable range reported for other amyloid classes. Unlike those classes, where binder beta-sheet-forming amino acid propensity correlated strongly with predicted binding success, no such relationship was detected for tau (Pearson r=-0.19, p=0.50; n=15 designs), and the highest-scoring tau design is an alpha-helical bundle rather than a beta-sheet, suggesting a mechanistically distinct interaction mode. This is, to our knowledge, the first application of a modern diffusion-based generative design tool to tau fibrils, and the first evidence that resistance to generative binder design is not a universal property of amyloid geometry but varies by protein family independent of structural polymorph within that family.
items.summary_zh: 该计算基准以RFdiffusion3、ProteinMPNN和AlphaFold2-Multimer评估五种tau纤维折叠对生成式结合蛋白设计的可设计性。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 五种tauopathy折叠均未达到先前可处理范围，提示蛋白家族层面的设计障碍值得实验检验；目前结果仅是结构预测基准。
items.abstract_zh: 扩散式骨架生成器等生成式蛋白结合蛋白设计工具，近来已在淀粉样纤维靶点上进行了基准测试，结果发现成功与否取决于具体结构多态性而非疾病来源：有些纤维折叠可处理，另一些则普遍具有抵抗性。此种多态性依赖性是否能泛化到tau——Alzheimer's disease中的聚集蛋白以及一类非Alzheimer's tauopathies中的聚集蛋白——尚未检验。我们以RFdiffusion3、强制ProteinMPNN序列重新设计和共同的AlphaFold2-Multimer预言机，对横跨5种tauopathies的5种不同冷冻电镜tau纤维折叠进行基准测试：Alzheimer's disease（paired helical filament）、chronic traumatic encephalopathy、Pick's disease、corticobasal degeneration和progressive supranuclear palsy。与AL amyloidosis和alpha-synuclein所报道的多态性依赖模式相反，所有5种tau折叠均对结合蛋白设计有抵抗性（各折叠最佳界面预测模板建模评分i_pTM为0.116-0.401），即使最可处理的折叠（progressive supranuclear palsy）也未达到其他淀粉样类别所报道的可处理范围。与其他类别中结合蛋白形成β-折叠的氨基酸倾向与预测结合成功强相关不同，tau中未检测到这种关系（Pearson r=-0.19，p=0.50；n=15个设计），且最高评分的tau设计是α螺旋束而非β-折叠，这提示一种机制上不同的相互作用模式。据我们所知，这是首次将现代扩散式生成设计工具应用于tau纤维，也是首个证据表明，对生成式结合蛋白设计的抵抗性并非淀粉样几何结构的普遍属性，而是在蛋白家族之间变化、且独立于该家族内的结构多态性。

items.title: Scalable Causal-Interpretable Machine Learning for Cancer Prescreening Using Electronic Health Records
items.abstract_or_text: Electronic health records provide a source of real-world information for disease risk prediction, but many machine learning models learn implicit associations that are difficult to inspect or use for clinical reasoning. Causal Bayesian networks (CBNs) offer a form of causal-interpretable machine learning by representing conditional dependencies, putative directional relations, and probabilistic evidence propagation in a directed acyclic graph. However, conventional CBN structure learning becomes unstable and computationally expensive when applied to large-scale EHR data. To address this limitation, we propose UPEBNL, a scalable framework for causal-interpretable cancer prescreening based on parallel CBN learning. UPEBNL integrates adaptive data slicing, quality-aware structure aggregation, and global DAG construction to learn stable and interpretable dependency structures from large-scale observational data. We evaluated UPEBNL in high-dimensional and multi-million-sample simulations and applied it to EHR-based prescreening for esophageal and colorectal cancer. In simulations, UPEBNL improved structural recovery accuracy by nearly 40% and achieved up to a 221.28-fold speedup over conventional CBN learning strategies. For cancer risk prediction, the learned CBNs provided interpretable evidence paths and achieved validation AUCs of 0.8171 for esophageal cancer and 0.784 for colorectal cancer. Calibration and decision curve analyses further supported the reliability and clinical utility of the models. These findings suggest that scalable CBN learning can support interpretable cancer prescreening from large-scale EHR data.
items.summary_zh: UPEBNL以并行因果贝叶斯网络学习支持大规模EHR癌症预筛查，并在模拟数据及食管癌、结直肠癌风险预测中评估。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 该工作兼顾结构学习速度、可解释路径、校准和决策曲线，但由观察性EHR学习的有向关系仍是模型假设，不能据此确认因果机制。
items.abstract_zh: 电子健康记录提供了疾病风险预测的真实世界信息来源，但许多机器学习模型学习到的是难以检查或用于临床推理的隐含关联。因果贝叶斯网络（CBN）通过在有向无环图中表示条件依赖、推定的方向关系和概率证据传播，提供了一种因果可解释机器学习形式。然而，将传统CBN结构学习应用于大规模EHR数据时会变得不稳定且计算成本高。为解决这一局限，我们提出UPEBNL，这是一种基于并行CBN学习、用于因果可解释癌症预筛查的可扩展框架。UPEBNL整合自适应数据切片、质量感知结构聚合和全局DAG构建，从大规模观察性数据中学习稳定且可解释的依赖结构。我们在高维和数百万样本模拟中评估UPEBNL，并将其应用于基于EHR的食管癌和结直肠癌预筛查。在模拟中，UPEBNL将结构恢复准确率提高近40%，相较传统CBN学习策略实现最高221.28倍加速。对于癌症风险预测，学习得到的CBN提供可解释证据路径，并在验证中达到食管癌AUC 0.8171和结直肠癌AUC 0.784。校准和决策曲线分析进一步支持模型的可靠性和临床效用。这些发现提示，可扩展CBN学习能够支持来自大规模EHR数据的可解释癌症预筛查。

items.title: Pretraining Beyond Birds: Multi-Taxa Acoustic Representation Learning for Pantanal Biodiversity Monitoring
items.abstract_or_text: Abstract Passive acoustic monitoring enables scalable biodiversity assessment, yet automated species identification remains challenging in multi-taxa ecosystems. We present a deep learning pipeline for BirdCLEF 2026, targeting 234 species across five taxonomic classes in the Pantanal wetland of Brazil, achieving AUROC 0.960 (public) and 0.959 (private), ranking 19th selected and 3rd unselected. Three key contributions emerge from 288 systematic experiments. First, multi-taxa backbone pretraining on 9,257 species including Amphibia, Insecta, Mammalia, and Reptilia yields +0.016 AUROC over bird-only pretraining — critical as 31% of target species are non-bird. Second, we identify a calibration-quality paradox in pseudo-label generation: a better-calibrated teacher model (AUROC 0.946) produces lower-quality pseudo labels than a weaker teacher (AUROC 0.930), degrading performance by 0.032 AUROC. Third, taxonomic smoothing — blending predictions with genus and class means — provides a zero-cost +0.001 AUROC gain. Our findings offer practical guidance for multi-taxa bioacoustic monitoring in conservation applications.
items.summary_zh: 面向Pantanal生物多样性监测的多类群声学表征学习，在234个物种的BirdCLEF 2026任务中检验跨类群预训练、伪标签与分类学平滑。
items.why_it_matters_zh: 对9,257个物种预训练和288项系统实验表明，多类群预训练对含大量非鸟类目标的声学监测有增益；结果来自竞赛数据集。
items.abstract_zh: 被动声学监测可实现可扩展的生物多样性评估，但在多类群生态系统中，自动物种识别仍具挑战。我们提出一个用于BirdCLEF 2026的深度学习流水线，面向巴西Pantanal湿地5个分类类群中的234个物种，在公开集上达到AUROC 0.960、私有集上达到0.959，在入选队伍中排名第19、未入选队伍中排名第3。288项系统实验产生了三项关键贡献。第一，在包括Amphibia、Insecta、Mammalia和Reptilia在内的9,257个物种上进行多类群骨干网络预训练，相比仅鸟类预训练提高+0.016 AUROC；这一点很关键，因为31%的目标物种不是鸟类。第二，我们在伪标签生成中识别出校准-质量悖论：校准更好的教师模型（AUROC 0.946）产生的伪标签质量低于较弱教师模型（AUROC 0.930），使性能下降0.032 AUROC。第三，分类学平滑——将预测与属和纲的均值混合——以零成本带来+0.001 AUROC提升。我们的发现为保护应用中的多类群生物声学监测提供了实用指导。

review.note: 共选13项，均为preprint；已按目标日前综合日报归档核验，未发现相同DOI、URL或ID的既往报道。排序优先考虑临床/实验依据、数据规模、方法创新与可复现性；预测性与观察性结果均不作因果或临床有效性表述。
